processing_summary: 55 transparent registered frames with common apparent scale across directions and gaits. 24 editable horizontal direction strips; mirrors baked into export pixels.

review.running_status: All direction studies integrated; targeted east arm and diagonal pose corrections applied. Remaining pose and size variation needs final art approval.
review.scale_refinement: Direction/gait area normalized; head and torso proportions still require visual review.

normalization.method: Alpha-weighted silhouette area; one uniform scale per direction and gait. Idle shares walk scale.
